name: player_keeptradecut_position_rank requested twice differing only by qb emits two distinct joins (executed-result parity)
description: generate_table_alias keys on is_superflex because it is a join PREDICATE, not just a display parameter -- before this fix, two requests for one metric differing only by params.qb collapsed onto one alias and silently rendered the 1QB value under the superflex column. Seed a player with a clearly different position_rank at is_superflex=false (qb=1, rank 15) vs is_superflex=true (qb=2, rank 3), and request the same column twice with params.qb 1 and 2. The two output columns must resolve to two DISTINCT joins in the SQL (visible as two differently-predicated aliases in expected_query) and must return two DIFFERENT values (15 and 3) rather than one value duplicated onto both columns.
expected_query: select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "t7c0566345ba7c64f33a955806666e789"."position_rank" AS "player_keeptradecut_position_rank_0", "tbf04492c2be2dffcbb2d34ce116d8cdf"."position_rank" AS "player_keeptradecut_position_rank_1", "player"."primary_position" from "player" left join "keeptradecut_valuations" as "t7c0566345ba7c64f33a955806666e789" on "t7c0566345ba7c64f33a955806666e789"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "t7c0566345ba7c64f33a955806666e789"."is_superflex" = false and "t7c0566345ba7c64f33a955806666e789"."observed_at" = (select MAX(observed_at) from "keeptradecut_valuations" where "pid" = player.pid and "is_superflex" = false and "position_rank" is not null) left join "keeptradecut_valuations" as "tbf04492c2be2dffcbb2d34ce116d8cdf" on "tbf04492c2be2dffcbb2d34ce116d8cdf"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "tbf04492c2be2dffcbb2d34ce116d8cdf"."is_superflex" = true and "tbf04492c2be2dffcbb2d34ce116d8cdf"."observed_at" = (select MAX(observed_at) from "keeptradecut_valuations" where "pid" = player.pid and "is_superflex" = true and "position_rank" is not null) where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "t7c0566345ba7c64f33a955806666e789"."position_rank", "tbf04492c2be2dffcbb2d34ce116d8cdf"."position_rank", "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
